specs.max_nota: unverified: third-party guides report 10 min in-app recording, uploads up to 30-60 min for many accounts (staged rollout). The app shows each account's real limit. 600 s is the safe value for this pipeline.
specs.ideal_nota: Creator Rewards Program pays only for original videos longer than 1 minute, so an educational series that wants monetisation should land at 61-90 s. For pure reach tests, 20-45 s is the usual heuristic (unverified). TikTok's own statement: finishing a longer video from beginning to end is a heavier signal than weaker interactions.

safe_area.nota: unverified: TikTok publishes safe zones for ads in Ads Manager; organic values here are a conservative mix of third-party templates (top 100-130 status/tabs, bottom 250-380 caption + sound, right ~100-140 action column). Check in the app preview before a new layout.

caption_limit.nota: 4000 characters in the app (raised from 2200); some schedulers report 2200 through the Content Posting API (unverified). Only the first ~55 characters show in the feed before 'more' (unverified).

specs.cover: Pick a cover frame and add cover text in the app. The cover shows on the profile grid (cropped toward 3:4, unverified) and in search results: keep the title text centred, inside the middle 1080x1440 band.

algoritmo: TikTok's own statement: recommendations rank on user interactions (likes, shares, follows, comments, content created), video information (captions, sounds, hashtags) and, with lower weight, device and account settings (language, country, device).
Stronger signals weigh more: 'whether a user finishes watching a longer video from beginning to end' receives greater weight than weaker ones.
Neither follower count nor previous high-performing videos are direct factors: every video starts from zero, which suits a new faceless/avatar channel.
Captions, on-screen keywords and sounds feed both recommendations and TikTok search; plain-text keywords matter as much as hashtags (third-party consensus).

STEM feed: educational science/tech content that passes two checks (appropriateness by Common Sense Networks, reliability by the Poynter Institute) can enter a dedicated STEM feed in the US, Europe and other markets. Art history is not STEM; art-science crossovers (pigment chemistry, X-ray conservation) may qualify (unverified for art topics).
Creator Rewards Program: original videos over 1 minute; 18+, 10,000 followers and 100,000 views in the last 30 days (criteria from 2024 coverage, may have changed).
estrategia: Say the key idea within the first 3 seconds and land the full hook within 6 (TikTok's ad creative guidance; directional for organic).
Write the spoken hook, the on-screen hook text and the caption's first 5 words as three versions of the same promise.
Keyword the caption like a search query: '<artist> <artwork> hidden detail explained'.
Series: 'Part N' in on-screen text and caption; use TikTok playlists by series (Series/Collections on the profile).
Reply-with-video to good comments: a cheap second episode with a built-in audience.
Over-1-minute versions for Creator Rewards; keep the payoff after the 60 s mark so the full watch is earned, but never pad.
cta: 'Follow for part 2' only when part 2 exists or is scheduled (series cliffhanger).
Two-option comment question at the end, framed as an opinion ('Genius or fraud?'), not 'comment YES'.
Save prompt for list-style content: 'Save this for your next museum visit.'

hashtags_seo.caption: Lead with the keyword phrase; 1-2 sentences; 3-5 focused hashtags (#arthistory #<artist> #<museum> #learnontiktok). One scheduler claims only the first 5 hashtags count (unverified).
hashtags_seo.texto_en_pantalla: Say and show the searchable terms (artist, artwork); on-screen text and speech are read for search (third-party consensus, unverified).
hashtags_seo.busqueda: Check TikTok search suggestions for the artist name to choose the exact phrasing.

musica: Personal accounts: general sound library (licensed for personal, non-commercial use). Business accounts: only the Commercial Music Library in the app (pre-cleared, 1M+ tracks per vendors). Music added before upload must be licensed by you. For this pipeline: own/generated music; avoid trending commercial songs on a business account; post as a personal/creator account if trending sounds are part of the strategy.

ia_disclosure.obligatorio: TikTok requires creators to label AI-generated or significantly edited content that shows realistic-looking scenes or people (Community Guidelines, Integrity and Authenticity).
ia_disclosure.como: Toggle 'AI-generated content' in the post settings before publishing. TikTok also auto-labels content carrying C2PA Content Credentials (since May 2024) and adds an invisible watermark to content made with its tools.
ia_disclosure.consecuencias: Unlabeled content may be removed, restricted, or labeled by TikTok depending on harm. Labels do not make misleading content about matters of public importance allowed.
ia_disclosure.para_esta_app: Photoreal presenter = realistic-looking person: always toggle the AI label. Keep C2PA metadata if the generators write it (it triggers the label automatically anyway).

publicacion.cadencia: Widely attributed to TikTok creator resources: 1-4 posts per day to test (unverified, no primary page found). For a produced series: 1 per day or 4-5 per week, plus cheap reply videos.
publicacion.horas: No official best time. Use TikTok Studio analytics (follower activity by hour) after ~2 weeks of posting (unverified heuristic).

adaptar_desde_master: Keep 9:16 1080x1920 30 fps; upload the master file, not a re-export with a watermark from another app (Instagram demotes watermarked reposts, and TikTok-watermarked files are a cross-posting tell).
Keep burned-in subtitles above y=1540 and text left of x=940; the bottom 380 px hold caption and sound.
If the episode is over 60 s keep it (Creator Rewards); if under, consider extending with a second beat only if it adds real content.
Caption: keyword-first description (not the YouTube title).
Swap the music if the account is a business account and the track is not cleared commercially.
